New test in src/tests/v2/acp-v2.test.ts: a v2 session/fork of a client that opted into the neutral fork point, with both configOptions (mode plan) and _meta.forkPoint, returns the mode it asked for and _meta.forkPoint { boundary, messageId, matchedBy }. Red proofs (disabled in place): upstream's exact response line `{ sessionId, ...(await this.setupFields(session)) }` fails the new test and the existing v2 fork test; dropping upstream's setInitialConfigOptions call (a resolution that takes the patch side) fails the new test. Files: those of the original only. Stable patch-id e7691fca, distinct from every ledger commit.
